What Rheto Does  
Rheto helps you create high-quality content for TikTok, Reels, YouTube, and more – fast!  
Whether you're launching a new product, testing an idea, or just want to create a professional video without stuttering, Rheto gives you the confidence you need.

Core Features  
• Smart Teleprompter: Never forget your lines again. Rheto scrolls your script in sync with your speaking pace.  
• Script Import: Write your own text or upload it instantly as a PDF.  
• Rheto Academy: Learn how to create better content with helpful tips and guidance.

Why Rheto?  
• No more awkward pauses or mistakes  
• Full control with advanced settings  
• Save time recording video and audio content  
• Simple and clean design for easy use

You get access to Rheto PRO via In-App Purchase.

Support  
If you need help or have questions, feel free to reach out: info@setupfast.net

show_hn.title: Show HN: Struggling with Marketing? Try UGC with My App

quotes.text:
User-generated content is one of the most effective ways to market a product — but let’s be honest, not everyone feels confident in front of a camera. At least I am not.

Stumbling over your words, forgetting your lines, or sounding unnatural can make recording a painful process.
Especially as a non native English speaker this can be frustrating ‘:)

That’s why I built Rheto – a lightweight but powerful teleprompter app for creators, indie devs, and solo founders who want to record better content without the stress.

Why Rheto?:

* 3 Teleprompter Modes: Choose between a simple teleprompter, audio recording, or full video recording with script overlay.
* Flexible Script Input: Write scripts directly in the app or import them from PDF files.
* Creator-Focused Learning: The built-in Rheto Academy offers tips and content strategies to improve your delivery.
* Highly Customizable UI: Adjust text size, colors, and more – so the experience fits your workflow and style.

Rheto uses Apple’s native speech recognition to sync the script flow with your voice – so it scrolls as you speak. No clunky remotes or constant tapping.

It’s available now on the App Store for iPhone & iPad. There's a free plan to try it out – no login required.

It’s my third App and I hope I finally land a good product market fit.

Also I was wondering if the name in the App Store could be ASO Optimized (Rheto: Smart Teleprompter).
Happy to hear your thoughts, feedback, or suggestions! :-)
